judge.notes: No options were shown, so there are no distractors to judge. I opened no files because none were named. I checked the geometry directly. The tangent-chord angle gives ∠C = ∠DBA, and XY ∥ BD gives ∠BXY = ∠DBA. So XYCA is cyclic, and ∠XYC = 180° − ∠A. The keys are 140, 96 and 131. As a cross-check on the first instance, triangle BXY has angles 80°, 60° and 40°, so ∠XYC = 180° − 40° = 140°. All three instances give a valid triangle: the angle at B is 80°, 19° and 39°. The "prove" part is a short reasoned sketch, which is acceptable for a numeric key.
